caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object resembling a decorative wrought iron stand or holder. The object is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a monochromatic appearance. It features a vertical central rod topped with a pointed tip that has small decorative elements on its sides. Attached perpendicularly to the central rod is a horizontal bar, shaped like an arrow with a pointed arrowhead on one end and fletching on the other, with ornamental scrollwork in the middle, above and below the bar. The base consists of three wide, splayed legs with ornate curves and cut-out sections, connected by additional horizontal supports. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or features in the composition.
title: Weather Vane
